narr: Moisture from the remnants of Pacific Tropical Storm Mario fueled scattered thunderstorms, many of which produced flash flooding.
ev: Amboy Road was flooded, and the pavement broke apart. Multiple cars were stuck.

Adobe Road was flooded between Amboy Road and Indian Trail.
The intersection of Sunfair Road and Cobalt Road was flooded.

There were two feet of standing water at the intersection of Highways 190 and 127, water and debris over Highway 190 at Furnace Creek, and the following roads were closed: Badwater Road from Jubilee Road to Highway 190, all of West Side Road, and all of Twenty Mule Team Road.
Flash flooding on Main Street between Lenwood Road and Sweeten Lane swept away a car, killing a two-year old boy and injuring his father.
